ebay.note: US non-Store most-category estimate: 13.6% through $7,500 and 2.35% above it; $0.30 order fee through $10, $0.40 above. Includes buyer-paid shipping and entered marketplace-collected tax in the fee base. Category, Store, ads and account charges vary.

poshmark.note: US item price: $2.95 below $15; 20% at $15 or above. Enter seller-paid shipping discounts, fee tax and other charges separately. Editing fee fields switches to Custom. Buyer-paid Poshmark postage is not seller revenue; enter only shipping discounts or other shipping costs you bear.

mercari.note: US seller estimate: 10% of item price plus buyer-paid shipping for listings using the fee structure effective January 6, 2025. Enter optional transfer, return or other charges separately.

facebook.note: Illustrative local cash pickup assumption only: no platform transaction fee entered. This is not a verified Facebook shipping/checkout fee preset. Adjust to your actual transaction charges.

custom.note: Enter your actual seller fee rate, fixed order fee and costs. No marketplace fee rule is assumed.
